xfail.approved#ready: AI-first Stage 3: Retail Win-back is built from one event table. The combine keeps one row per customer, so the orders' dates are gone from the joined table. A query over the orders themselves passes its trial (the AI wrote one in the P6c fix round) but cannot be applied: a query is a post-build step and the run gives it one working table, so approval stops with SQL_INPUT_MISSING. The Doctor asks for an outcome column.
